items.name: Corn on the cob pieces (2 short segments)
items.fdc_query: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
items.preparation: Cob cut into two short rounds, appears boiled or steamed, no visible butter or seasoning. Mass includes the kernels only, with the cob core excluded from the edible portion.

fdc.description: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

rows: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels on cob, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

scale_cues: The square white plate is about 24-26 cm across. Each corn segment is about 8 cm wide, which is about a third of the plate width. This fits a 3-4 cm long cob round, about 80-100 g each with the cob. The wooden-framed tray is a secondary reference.
assumptions: Both pieces are sweet yellow corn cob segments, plain and cooked.
No butter, oil or salt is visible, so none is included.
Edible mass is estimated as kernels only, with about 40-50% of the cob weight treated as non-edible core.
The plate holds no other food and no drink is visible.
